source: General_AI_Agent issue #17 (fc620af); after runs 20-24 the ticket says the name comes from the configuration (the first trial of a run, without repository memory, read it from the chain object three times running)

spec.title: Expose the connected AI model name in the chat response
spec.problem: The chat response does not say which AI model answered. Expose the model the backend is connected to (the configured Ollama model) as a `model` field in the agent run response, so the chat interface can display it. The name comes from the configuration (the `OLLAMA_MODEL` setting, with its default), not from a property of the chain object: tests build the agent with fake chains, and `model` must still be the configured name then.
acceptance_criteria: agent.run() returns a `model` string naming the connected model.
Existing behaviour and tests are preserved; the response-shape test includes the new key.
